title: Adventurer
wikitext:
Adventurers is the lore name for Player Characters.
Although unnamed and numerous, it is thanks to these brave individuals Azeroth was saved numerous of times in recent (and past) times.

== Races and classes ==

The adventurers mostly come from either of the two larger factions on [[Azeroth]],being the [[Horde]] and the [[Alliance]]. 
As such, most of them are of the 5 larger races of each faction.
Namely [[Humans]], [[Orcs]], [[Forsaken]], [[Darkspear Trolls]],[[Dwarves]] ,[[Gnomes]], [[High Elves]], [[Night elves]], [[Goblins]] and [[Tauren]]. 


== Loyalty ==

Adventurers are mostly loyal to their faction, [[Horde]] or [[Alliance]] , but are willing to work for other neutral organizations such as the [[Argent Dawn]], [[Booty Bay]], etc. for either gold or faction rewards.

== Power ==

Where the regiment of Orc grunts or Human footmen fail, the adventurers succeed. 
Many are one-man armies, being able to defeat a large number of enemies, whilst even getting stronger. 

== Known actions ==

Though uncertain why or how, the adventurers saved the day numerous of times in recent times. Examples ranging from stopping Orgrimmar's corruption from [[Ragefire Chasm]] to stopping the prisoners escaping in the [[Stockades]].
Also they have aided in re-opening the [[Gates of Ahn'Qiraj]] and fighting off the Scourge during the [[Scourge Invasion]].
